newsitem.title: USA: Elsag Bailey sees Q4 below expectations.
newsitem.headline: Elsag Bailey sees Q4 below expectations.

text.p: Elsag Bailey Process Automation NV said on Tuesday that soft markets and order levels from recent quarters may lead to fourth quarter results that fall below analysts' estimates.
The company could not be reached immediately for details on analysts' estimates. However, First Call's mean estimate for that period is $0.98 per share.
Elsag Bailey said that period's results may fall below estimates even though it expects its financial performance for the quarter to rebound.
Company Managing Director and Chief Executive Vincenzo Cannatelli said in a statement that the company has spent the past nine month seeking to reduce overall costs and undergoing a restructuring.
He said the reduced costs have partially offset the effects of a strengthening dollar and lower-than-expected volumes caused by soft market conditions in some areas of its business.
Market conditions in some European countries, including Germany, remain weak, particularly for large-system projects.
The company said it is seeing a downturn in Japan, while electricity utility spending remains flat in North America.
The company said it anticipates a gradual improvement for European markets and an increase in automation spending by U.S. electric utility companies in the coming years.

"Much has been accomplished during 1996 through our restructuring efforts and the introduction of new technologies which will greatly benefit our clients and our shareholders," Cannatelli said. "We believe that we can build on these actions and expect to see evidence of this continued improvement in our 1997 results."
Elsag Bailey supplies process automation systems, instrumentation products, analytical measurement devices and related professional services.
